request.description: Creates a master product template along with a Cartesian matrix of sellable variants, each having independent pricing (purchase_price, selling_price, mrp), attributes, and opening stock allocations.
Creates an individual ad-hoc child variant linked to an existing parent template ID. Category, Brand, Tax Rate, and Currency are inherited automatically if omitted.
Updates variant-specific purchase price, selling price, and MRP without affecting the parent template or sibling variants.
Links a multi-pack or carton rule (e.g., Case of 24) to a product or variant. Scanning the package barcode or QR adjusts inventory by the specified quantity.
Retrieves all packaging rules (boxes, packs, cartons) configured for a given product or variant.
Deletes a specific packaging rule by its packaging ID.

request.description: Fetches real-time stock balances across all products and warehouses, with average daily sales velocity and reorder level indicators.

Returns only products that have reached or breached their reorder threshold.
Returns stock alert notifications triggered by the automated inventory engine.
Marks a specific reorder notification alert as read.
